title: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0 Crosswalk

controls.requirement: Requirement 1: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
controls.title: Network security controls (NSCs) are configured and maintained
controls.description: Establish firewall and router configurations that restrict connections between untrusted networks and system components in the cardholder data environment (CDE).

controls.title: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment is restricted
controls.description: Prohibit direct public access between the Internet and any system component in the cardholder data environment. SSH port 22 and RDP port 3389 must never be exposed to 0.0.0.0/0.

controls.title: Primary account number (PAN) is secured wherever it is stored
controls.description: Render PAN unreadable anywhere it is stored using strong cryptography with associated key-management processes (AES-256 or KMS CMK).

controls.title: Cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data are secured
controls.description: Protect cryptographic keys used for encryption of account data against disclosure and misuse through Customer Managed Keys with annual rotation.

controls.requirement: Requirement 7: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
controls.title: Access to system components and data is limited to only those with a business need
controls.description: Enforce strict least privilege access control systems. Restrict unconstrained wildcard actions in IAM policies.

controls.requirement: Requirement 10: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
controls.title: Audit logs are implemented to support the detection of anomalies and suspicious activity
controls.description: Record automated audit trails across multi-region cloud infrastructures to reconstruct all individual user access to cardholder data.
